status: PRELIMINARY DESIGN - geometry review and prototype development, not manufacturing release

geometry.mount_thread: M1.4 x 0.3, full thread depth 1.0 mm from base datum; proposed, supplier review required

electromagnetics.topology: three-phase radial-flux outer rotor, 12 slots / 14 poles, double-layer tooth coils, star connection
electromagnetics.airgap_B_note: Sensitivity assumptions only. No magnetic FEM or measured flux has been performed.
electromagnetics.magnet_material: N35SH sintered NdFeB, 14 custom radially magnetized arc segments; alternate inward N/S; epoxy protective coating
electromagnetics.stator_material: 0.20 mm insulated non-oriented electrical steel, supplier to provide B-H and loss curves
electromagnetics.rotor_yoke_material: low-carbon magnetic steel; supplier B-H curve required
electromagnetics.loss_budget_note: Exploration budget, NOT verified continuous rating. Full assembly thermal test required.

integration.fit_scope: motor cartridge against supplied V8.3 case/back cover plus Rev B populated main board; main board placement uses existing BodyV6.13 datum; whole-system V8.3 board fit not recertified
integration.mounting: Three M1.4 holes on cartridge base. Separate stationary adapter to old encoder-board supports required; adapter and external wire routing not inside cartridge envelope and not released in R0.
integration.sensor: MT6701QT-STD QFN16 mechanical maximum envelope; 3.3 V I2C proposed, SSI option requires extra signal
integration.sensor_magnet_note: Custom D4 x 0.5 diametric magnet is not the datasheet reference magnet. Field amplitude, gradients, nearby steel and phase-current interference must be validated.
integration.electrical_tail: U,V,W phase wires plus 3V3,GND,SDA,SCL; strain relief and separation from phase wiring required. Existing 4-pin GND/A/B/GND cable is incompatible.
integration.firmware: SF32 FOC feasibility not yet benchmarked; dedicated timer control loop, synchronized current sampling and driver shutdown required
